about: М25: translations into English with a known verdict under the lenient rule: a translation is wrong only when it is clearly wrong — it says something else (another action, thing or person, the opposite, a missing or extra "not"), leaves out the main point or cannot be understood; small slips (tense, articles, endings, prepositions, word order, spelling) and other wordings are right. Measures the chrF++ threshold and, before the on-device model may check translations, the model. Sources and references are Tatoeba sentences (CC BY 2.0 FR); responses are written for the test.
